findings.current: At the edge of this vast realm, in Liaoning Province—the true frontier—the descendants of the Xianbei, once a people who had proclaimed themselves rulers of their own kingdom centuries ago, had long since secured their place among the Five Great Families.
findings.defect: Omits the Murong Family’s dominance of Liaoning and changes the ancestors’ claim to be kings of a nation into a claim about ruling their own kingdom.
findings.rationale: 요녕성의 패자 identifies them as Liaoning’s dominant power; 일국의 왕을 자처하던 describes their ancestors’ claim to kingship.
findings.replacement: The descendants of the Xianbei, whose ancestors had proclaimed themselves kings of a nation centuries ago, ruled Liaoning Province—the true frontier—and had long since secured their place among the Five Great Families.
findings.source: 진정한 변방이라 할 수 있는 요녕성(遼寧省)의 패자이자 수백 여년 전 일국의 왕을 자처하던 선비족의 후예들은 오대 세가의 일원으로 당당히 자리매김한 지 오래였다.

findings.current: The real north. A lawless land full of people more ruthless than the Murim, with every kind of hidden scheme and blade lurking in its depths.
findings.defect: Moves the lurking schemes and blades from the Murim to the grasslands, altering the comparison.
findings.rationale: 온갖 암수와 창칼이 도사린 modifies 무림; the northern land is being compared against that dangerous Murim.
findings.replacement: The real north. A land of outlaws even more lawless than the Murim, where hidden schemes and blades lurked at every turn.
findings.source: 진정한 의미의 북부. 온갖 암수와 창칼이 도사린 무림보다 더한 무법자들의 땅.

findings.current: The Beggars’ Sect was a sign of people coming in.
findings.defect: Mistakes the ordinary noun 개방, meaning opening, for the identically written organization name and invents the Beggars’ Sect’s involvement.
findings.rationale: The preceding line describes newly opened trade routes; the following lines explain how people, including Peng informants, entered through them.
findings.replacement: Opening the trade routes meant opening the way for people, too.

findings.current: “What are the chances they’ve joined hands with Dark Heaven—the bastards I wouldn’t mind tearing limb from limb?”
findings.defect: Softens an expression of hatred into a statement that he would not mind harming them.
findings.rationale: 찢어 죽여도 시원치 않을 means even tearing them apart would not satisfy his anger.
findings.replacement: “What are the chances they’ve joined hands with Dark Heaven—those bastards I could tear to pieces and still not feel satisfied?”
findings.source: “암천. 그 찢어 죽여도 시원치 않을 놈들과 손을 잡았을 가능성은 얼마나 되느냐?”

findings.current: “And that’s not all. The year before, Second Uncle dozed off for a moment during a meeting, so you punched him in the—”
findings.defect: Drops the mention of the jaw that sets up Second Uncle’s correction.
findings.rationale: 아구창 specifies the mouth or jaw; Second Uncle’s reply corrects where he was struck, not an entirely unspoken accusation.
findings.replacement: “And that’s not all. The year before, Second Uncle dozed off for a moment during a meeting, so you punched him in the jaw—”
findings.source: “그뿐입니까? 재작년에는 둘째 숙부께서 회의 중에 잠시 졸았다고 아구창을…….”

findings.current: Peng Cheolyeong, the current Family Head of the Hebei Peng Family, silently endured the booming shout before speaking up.
findings.defect: Omits Peng Cheolyeong’s established epithet on his introduction.
findings.rationale: 철혈도 is present as his title in the source and has the established rendering Iron Blood Saber.
findings.replacement: Peng Cheolyeong, the Iron Blood Saber and current Family Head of the Hebei Peng Family, silently endured the booming shout before speaking up.
findings.source: 쩌렁쩌렁한 고함을 묵묵히 받아 내던 하북팽가의 현 가주, 철혈도(鐵血刀) 팽철영이 입을 열었다.

findings.current: Muttering to himself, the Thunderbolt Saber King stared intently at his eldest son.
findings.defect: Turns an internal thought into audible muttering.
findings.rationale: 마음속으로 explicitly places the utterance in his mind.
findings.replacement: The Thunderbolt Saber King kept that thought to himself as he stared intently at his eldest son.
findings.source: 마음속으로 뇌까린 벽력도왕은 자신의 맏아들을 물끄러미 응시했다.

summary: The draft has two substantive errors in its account of the northern regions and trade-route infiltration, plus several localized losses of meaning.
